Tabaahi aur barbaadi hai har taana-zan aur chughalkhor ke liye
Jis ne maal ko jama kiya aur khoob us ka hisaab rakha
Us ka khayaal tha ke ye maal use hamesha baaqi rakhega
Hargiz nahin, use yaqeenan Hutama mein daal diya jaaega
Aur tum kya jaano ke Hutama kya shai hai
Ye Allah ki bhadkaai hui aag hai
Woh aag un ke oopar gher di jaaegi
